name: cattle-manager
description: Cattle Manager — herd records, vaccinations and compliance for commercial cattle owners.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run migrate && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:vercel: npm --prefix backend ci --omit=dev && npm --prefix frontend ci --include=dev
